structure.unit: Regulation of Gas and Oil Development and Production

law.catch_line: Powers, duties, and responsibilities of the Inspector

text.section: The Inspector or another Department employee as determined by the Director shall serve as the principal executive of the staff of the Board.

The Inspector may take charge of well or corehole operations or pipeline emergency operations whenever a well or corehole blowout, release of hydrogen sulfide or other gas, or other serious accident occurs.
